```{r packages}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(ggrain)

install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("reshape2")
install.packages("ggrain")

library(codebook)
library(ggplot2)

```


### H1 Hypothesis Graph
```{r H1 Graph - Violin}
# Remove rows with missing gender or relationship constraint scores
h1PlotData <- h1Data[
  !is.na(h1Data$Sex) & !is.na(h1Data$relmob),
]

# Create the H1 violin plot
h1Violin <- ggplot(
  data = h1PlotData,
  aes(x = Sex, y = relmob, fill = Sex)
) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12) +
  labs(
    x = "Gender identity",
    y = "Perceived constraints on leaving a relationship",
    title = "Perceived constraints on leaving a relationship by gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

h1Violin

```
```{r H1 Graph Box Plot}
h1Box<-ggplot(
  data = h1PlotData,
  aes(x = Sex, y = relmob, fill = Sex)
) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(x="Gender Identity",
       y="Perceived constraints on leaving a relationship",
       title = "Perceived constraints on leaving a relationship by gender") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

h1Box
```


### H2 Hypothesis Graph

```{r H2 Graph - Scatter plot}
H2Point <- ggplot(data=h2Data_complete,
                  aes(x=Time_social_media,
                      y=Appearance_time))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(x="daily time spent on social media",
       y="daily time spent enhancing appearance",
       title="Relation between daily time spent on social media and daily time spent enhancing appearance")+
  theme_minimal(base_size=8)

H2Point

nrow(h2Data)
nrow(unique(h2Data[,c("Time_social_media","Appearance_time")]))

#jitter 

H2Jitter <- ggplot(data = h2Data_complete,
                   aes(x = Time_social_media, 
                       y = Appearance_time)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, width = 0.2, height = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Daily time spent on social media",
    y = "Daily time spent enhancing appearance",
    title = "Relation between daily time spent on social media and daily time spent enhancing appearance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

H2Jitter

#add line (Smooth)

h2line<- H2Jitter + geom_smooth(method = "lm")
h2line
```

```{r Save figures}
dir.create("figures",showWarnings=FALSE)
ggsave("figures/H1_figrue_Violin.png", plot=h1Violin, width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
ggsave("figures/H2_figure_Point.png", plot = h2line, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("figures/H1_figrue_BoxPlot.png", plot=h1Box, width=10,height=6,dpi=300)

```
